title: Celestial Chess Energy Forge
description: A mystical chess altar floats beneath a godrays sun-temple. The player must channel divine light energy into chess pieces by dragging godrays emitters to illuminate specific pieces, building up an energy conservation system where total light energy across all pieces remains constant. Undo/redo lets the player rewind energy transfers as they solve the puzzle of distributing exactly the right energy to each piece.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with es-module-shims). Load ABeautifulGame.glb (a chess set) and godrays_demo.glb (a sun/cathedral scene with light shafts). Place the chess board centered at origin on a reflective dark platform. Extract 3-4 luminous orb meshes from the godrays scene and position them floating above the board as draggable energy emitters. Implement an energy conservation system: total energy is fixed at 100 units, distributed among 6 highlighted chess pieces (king, queen, 2 rooks, 2 bishops — find them by mesh name or index). Each piece displays a glowing aura ring whose color shifts blue-to-gold based on its energy (0-100). Dragging an orb over a piece and clicking transfers 10 energy units from a global pool. Right-clicking a piece withdraws 10 units back. The conservation law enforces that total distributed energy never exceeds 100. Add a target configuration panel (top-right HTML overlay) showing required energy per piece (e.g., King:30, Queen:20, Rook1:15, Rook2:15, Bishop1:10, Bishop2:10). Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y storing each energy transfer as a state snapshot. Add keyboard shortcuts: R to reset all energy, T to toggle a top-down camera view. Use OrbitControls for default camera at position (5,6,5) looking at origin. Add ambient light (0.3 intensity), a directional light casting shadows, and a point light on each orb that intensifies when dragged. When the correct energy distribution is achieved, trigger a victory animation: all pieces levitate and spin, orbs orbit the board, and a particle burst effect plays. Display move counter, energy remaining in pool, and undo/redo stack depth in an HTML HUD. Minimum 10 interaction steps to solve: 6 energy assignments plus at least 2 corrections requiring undo, plus camera toggle and final confirmation click on a 'Seal Energy' button.
